threshold_rationale: Set so no genuine orchid photograph is rejected, including images from outside this dataset. The ranges overlap, so no threshold separates both perfectly: at 0.55, 145/145 orchid images are accepted and 15/17 non-orchid images rejected (the two that pass are green plants). Refusing a genuinely diseased plant is the more harmful error for a grower.
note: Distance filter in front of the classifier. No retraining, so all reported disease metrics remain valid.
